svg.text: Everyday English - Small talk
Have you come across
anything worth watching
lately?
MEANING
A friendly invitation to share a recent film, show or video
recommendation.
IN CONTEXT
Have you come across anything worth watching lately? I
am looking for a good documentary.
USAGE NOTE
Come across means find by chance; worth + -ing
describes something deserving your time. Lately connects
naturally with the present perfect. Follow up on the
person’s taste.
CONVERSATION
A: Have you come across anything worth watching lately?
B: A documentary about city wildlife.
A: What stood out to you?
B: How animals adapt to places we overlook.
A: That sounds right up my alley. Where can I find it?
B: I will send you the link. What kinds of documentaries do
you enjoy?
A: Mostly nature films, especially ones set in cities.
B: Then this should suit you. Let me know what you think.
YOUR TURN
Recommend something briefly, then ask a follow-up
question about the other person’s interests.
